items.text: The first margin comment or reply you write in a graph that is under git, when you have not set **Your name**, now asks for a name once, so comments you share show who wrote them instead of reading "you" to everyone. The name is a Tine setting on this device, used in all graphs. Skipping is remembered for all graphs and is not asked again; the comment is written either way, and the setting stays under Settings > Editor (#841).

items.text: Scrolling up a long page with block embeds no longer throws the page back down, which could leave it stuck in one place (#810). The earlier fix for this issue in 0.9.0-beta.2 made these jumps more frequent. Tine now prepares outline windows and block bodies before they reach the visible area of their pane and keeps the reading position when they replace a placeholder. Remounted query and reference groups also keep their measured height.

items.text: The comment margin can be hidden, like Wide mode and Document mode: **Toggle comment margin** in the command palette, the shortcut **t** then **m** (rebindable under Settings → Keyboard shortcuts), or **Comment margin** in Settings → Appearance. Hidden, no comment is drawn anywhere (no margin column, no inline cards, no marked words, no counts) and the arrow keys skip them; the comments stay in the file and nothing is written. The choice is kept on this device. Writing a comment, or opening a link or search result that leads to one, shows the margin again (#845).
